grammar.summary: 本课讨论污染问题，运用了定语从句修饰各类污染源，用动名词与分词短语作主语和定语描述噪音现象，并通过 that 引导的同位语从句阐明噪音正是「更加隐蔽的污染」这一论点。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 that/which/who 引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课多次用 that 修饰 ways、sources、kind 等名词，补充说明垃圾处理方式与噪音来源，使罗列的信息条理清晰。

examples.en: When you come to think about it, there are only four ways you can deal with rubbish: dump it, burn it, turn it into something you can use again, attempt to produce less of it.
examples.cn: 当我们开始考虑垃圾问题时，我们只有4种对付垃圾的方法：倾倒、焚烧、把垃圾变成再生材料或试图少产生一些垃圾。

examples.en: The survey revealed a large number of sources of noise that we really dislike.
examples.cn: 这个调查揭示了我们所不喜欢的大量的噪间的来源。

points.title: 同位语从句 (Appositive Clause)
points.explanation: that 引导的同位语从句用于解释抽象名词（如 idea、fact、contention）的具体内容，that 只起连接作用不在从句中充当成分。本课用 that is noise 解释 an even more insidious kind of pollution 的具体所指，点明段落主旨。

examples.en: However, there is an even more insidious kind of pollution that particularly affects urban areas and invades our daily lives, and that is noise.
examples.cn: 但是，还有一种更加隐蔽有害的污染，它专门影响城镇地区，侵袭我们的日常生活，那就是噪音。

points.title: 分词作定语与状语 (Participles)
points.explanation: 现在分词和过去分词可作定语或状语，描述事物的状态与伴随动作。本课用 going off 修饰 burglar alarms、thundering 修饰 trucks、flying overhead 修饰 planes，生动刻画各类噪音源。

examples.en: Burglar alarms going off at any time of the day or night serve only to annoy passers-by and actually assist burglars to burgle.
examples.cn: 防盗警报器在白天和黑夜的任何时候都会响起来，它的作用只是骚扰过路行人，而实际上却帮助窃贼入室行窃。

examples.en: Lawn mowers whining on a summer's day, late-night parties in apartment blocks, noisy neighbors, vehicles of al kinds, especially large container trucks thundering through quiet village, planes and helicopters flying overhead, large radios carried round in public places and played at maximum volume.
examples.cn: 夏天呜呜作响的割草机，公寓楼里深夜聚会的喧哗声，大声吵闹的邻居，各式各样的车辆，特别是穿越寂静的村庄的集装箱卡车，从头顶飞过的飞机和直升机，被带到公共场所、音量开到最大的大功率收音机。

exercises.q: However, there is an even more insidious kind of pollution that particularly affects urban areas and invades our daily lives, and ______ is noise.
The survey revealed a large number of sources of noise ______ we really dislike.
Burglar alarms ______ off at any time of the day or night serve only to annoy passers-by and actually assist burglars to burgle.

用同位语从句填空：When you come to think about it, there are only four ways you can deal with rubbish: dump it, burn it, turn it into something you can use again, attempt to produce ______ of it.（填入表示「更少」的比较级词，与 produce 搭配）
下列哪个词与课文中 insidious 的含义最接近？
